prompt.text: Use code 1 for a table, 2 for a bar graph, 3 for a pictogram, 4 for a line graph and 5 for a pie chart. A canteen manager wants to compare the numbers sold for six meal categories without implying continuity. Enter the most suitable code only.

content.text: Ask whether the six meals form a sequence in time or a set of separate groups.

The six meals are separate categories with no order between them, and the manager wants to compare how many of each were sold. Ask which display compares separate categories without joining them together.
Bars show the numbers sold for each separate meal against one scale. A line graph would join the meals as if one led on to the next, which they do not.
